nodes.label: Home partner-logo marquee (non-lazy images)
nodes.rationale: Logos are not lazy-loaded: the track scrolls continuously so every logo is seconds from view; lazy loading made the second half of the loop pop in as empty tiles

nodes.label: Admin layout (app-admin-navbar + app-admin-sidebar + admin-main)
nodes.rationale: Shared admin page skeleton with toggleable sidebar and a stats-row of stat-box cards

nodes.label: Shared Folder file-explorer (folder tree + contents table)
nodes.rationale: Documents view uses a file-explorer layout: whole folder tree on the left, current folder contents as one table on the right
nodes.norm_label: shared folder file-explorer (folder tree + contents table)

nodes.label: Per-Portal Accent Theming (--portal-accent)
nodes.rationale: Nothing themed renders until the project lookup completes (booting spinner), avoiding a flash of default teal before repainting in the portal's own colour; .portal-scroll is the scroll container so scrollbar starts below fixed nav.

nodes.label: BASSIANA Marine Ecosystems Portal design mockup
nodes.norm_label: bassiana marine ecosystems portal design mockup

nodes.label: Density, font and divider data-attribute variants
nodes.rationale: data-density (compact/comfortable), data-font (geist/manrope/editorial) and data-dividers override root tokens
nodes.norm_label: density, font and divider data-attribute variants

nodes.label: Dark ocean theme tokens (teal accent #4ad6c4)
nodes.rationale: CSS custom properties on :root drive colors, fonts and spacing so variants can be switched via data-attributes

nodes.label: Portal Mode vs Legacy Navigation
nodes.rationale: Navbar renders portal-scoped links (portalLink(path)) when inside a project portal, else the legacy BASSIANA navbar; forceLegacyNav used for not-found portals.

nodes.label: Portal page search bar pattern
nodes.rationale: Shared Points page reuses the same search bar as the Events page
